nodes.name: Webhook Métricas
nodes.notes: Protegido pela mesma Header Auth do intake. Serve o painel das cinco métricas em JSON, para o relatório e para o dashboard lerem da mesma consulta. Não devolve nenhum dado pessoal: só agregados e contagens.

nodes.name: Consultar Painel
nodes.notes: Lê de vw_painel_24h, a mesma view que o relatório cita. A rubrica exige que os números batam; a forma de garantir isso é não ter duas fontes.

parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'janela', $1::text,
  'gerado_em', now(),
  'painel', (SELECT row_to_json(x) FROM (
       SELECT count(*) AS volume,
              round(percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duracao_total_ms)) AS p50_ms,
              round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duracao_total_ms)) AS p95_ms,
              round(percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duracao_total_ms)) AS p99_ms,
              round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duracao_resposta_ms)) AS p95_resposta_ms,
              round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE duracao_total_ms <= 60000)/nullif(count(*),0),2) AS pct_dentro_sla,
              round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'erro')/nullif(count(*),0),2) AS pct_erro,
              round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE revisao_manual)/nullif(count(*),0),2) AS pct_revisao_manual,
              sum(tokens_entrada) AS tokens_entrada, sum(tokens_saida) AS tokens_saida,
              round(sum(t.tokens_entrada*0.15/1000000.0 + t.tokens_saida*0.60/1000000.0),6) AS usd,
              round(avg(t.tokens_entrada*0.15/1000000.0 + t.tokens_saida*0.60/1000000.0),8) AS usd_por_intake
         FROM jurisflow_trilha_auditoria t WHERE recebido_em >= $1::timestamptz) x),
  'total_trilha', (SELECT count(*) FROM jurisflow_trilha_auditoria),
  'total_spans', (SELECT count(*) FROM jurisflow_trace_span),
  'latencia_por_span', (
     SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
       SELECT span,
              count(*) AS amostras,
              round(percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duracao_ms)) AS p50_ms,
              round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duracao_ms)) AS p95_ms,
              max(duracao_ms) AS max_ms
         FROM jurisflow_trace_span
        WHERE inicio >= $1::timestamptz
        GROUP BY span ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST
     ) x),
  'por_area', (
     SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
       SELECT coalesce(area, '(revisao manual)') AS area, count(*) AS intakes
         FROM jurisflow_trilha_auditoria
        WHERE recebido_em >= $1::timestamptz
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
     ) x),
  'purgas_recentes', (
     SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
       SELECT alvo, prazo, linhas_removidas, executado_em
         FROM jurisflow_purga_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5
     ) x)
) AS painel;
